title: Cluster J — gauṇa-rasa, compatibility and rasābhāsa (Texts 24-27) — COMPLETE, 13 pages — ALL CLUSTERS CLOSED

concepts.title: The Seven Secondary Rasas
concepts.description: exactly Bharata’s eight minus śr̥ṅgāra, so the primary/secondary line is the line between inherited and added

concepts.title: Six Degrees of Laughter: Smita to Atihasita
concepts.description: graded by how much tooth shows, allocated by rank, and the allocation defeated in the next sentence

concepts.title: Four Heroisms: Yuddha, Dāna, Dayā, Dharma-Vīra
concepts.description: one enthusiasm pointed four ways, with a category boundary drawn on a fact the actor does not have

concepts.title: The Refuser of Liberation as Hero
concepts.description: the tradition’s signature claim filed four levels down, with praise as its only symptom

concepts.title: Karuṇa-Rasa Requires Ignorance of Omnipotence
concepts.description: you cannot grieve for someone who cannot be harmed, and the exclusion list is the classes that know his majesty

concepts.title: Raudra-Rasa: The Anatomy of Anger at God
concepts.description: only the target varies, so the rasa sorts household positions — and the famous anger is expelled from it

concepts.title: Bhayānaka and the Dispute Over the Āśraya
concepts.description: a taxonomy corrected at the level of a case-ending, and a third structural role used once and never generalised

concepts.title: Viśvanātha’s Dissent: The Gauṇa-Rasas Are Really Vyabhicāri-Bhāvas
concepts.description: the retraction is at the close of Text 24 and is Rūpa’s own conclusion; three further Texts operate the demoted categories

concepts.title: The Compatibility Matrix and Virasatā
concepts.description: compatibility is a property of the host; every primary rasa refuses anger and anger refuses one of them

concepts.title: Aṅgī and Aṅga Rasa: Vāmana Concealing Opulence
concepts.description: a subordinated primary persists and a subordinated secondary is consumed — the operational definition of primary

concepts.title: Rasābhāsa: Uparasa, Anurasa, Aparasa
concepts.description: five counterfeits generated by negating five definitions, and a scheme that assumes fakes are defective

concepts.title: Rasābhāsa Does Not Apply to Rādhā
concepts.description: two exceptions, both persons, at the two poles of the fork — so incompatibility is a limit of hearts

concepts.title: All Twelve Rasas at Once: The Arena and the Hill
concepts.description: the only place Kṛṣṇa occupies the vessel slot, and a demonstration needing three rasas from his enemies
